message.content: Briar expresses confidence in Real Madrid's ability to maintain their momentum and succeed throughout the season. He believes that with the depth in the squad and the integration of new talent, Real Madrid has a solid chance to compete for every title. Additionally, Briar mentions that coach Ancelotti is adept at getting the best out of his players, especially in crucial moments. This confidence stems from Real Madrid's historical success and their recent performance, particularly the dramatic comeback against Manchester City that impressed Briar. Overall, Briar sees Real Madrid as capable of continuing their winning streak and challenging for multiple trophies.
